questions.question: Which command sequence proves that your Cloud TPU VM is both usable by JAX and no longer billing when you finish?
options: Running `gcloud compute tpus tpu-vm create` and closing your laptop lid when done

Running a Python check on the TPU VM that verifies `jax.default_backend() == 'tpu'` and a synchronized computation, copying receipts back, running `gcloud compute tpus tpu-vm delete`, and confirming `list` is empty
Checking `pip list` on your local laptop
questions.explanation: Only an in-process JAX check on the TPU VM confirms TPU device discovery and execution, and only `tpu-vm delete` verified by `tpu-vm list` stops Cloud TPU VM billing.
